one_liner_zh: Constellation 上一季 EPS 大幅低於預期43%，營收6.07億美元，獲利受市況拖累。
one_liner_en: Constellation missed EPS by 43% with $6.07B revenue, as market conditions weighed on profit.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 較預估大幅低43.11%，獲利顯著不及市場共識。
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏弱：EPS 大幅低於預期逾四成，反映電力批發價格、避險認列或天候等因素造成的季度劇烈波動，需釐清是否含一次性項目。短期股價對獲利失望敏感，但 AI 資料中心電力需求的長線邏輯未變。中期關鍵在核電產能變現與 PPA 簽訂。追蹤指標：電價避險部位、核電容量因子、新 PPA 進度與全年 EPS 指引。建議結合下一季強勁表現，判讀本季為循環性低點。
ai_view_en: Signal is soft: an EPS miss of over 40% reflects sharp quarterly volatility from wholesale power prices, hedge recognition, or weather; one-off items need clarification. Near-term the stock is sensitive to disappointment, but the long-term AI data-center power thesis is intact. Mid-term hinges on monetizing nuclear capacity and signing PPAs. Track hedge positions, nuclear capacity factors, new PPA progress, and full-year EPS guidance. With the following quarter's strength, read this quarter as a cyclical trough.
highlights_zh: 營收6.07億美元（B級），季節性規模較低。
獲利大幅 miss 可能反映電價、避險或一次性因素。
highlights_en: EPS of $1.38 fell far short of the $2.43 estimate (-43.11%).
Revenue of $6.07B reflected a seasonally lower scale.
The large miss may reflect power prices, hedging, or one-off factors.
risks_zh: 營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢不明。
電力批發價格與避險組合波動劇烈。
獲利季度間落差大，可預測性偏低。
risks_en: Revenue YoY was not provided, leaving the trend unclear.
Wholesale power prices and hedge positions swing sharply.
Large quarterly earnings variance lowers predictability.
